dxrender.settings.title: DX Render Settings
dxrender.settings.restart: The new render mode takes effect after restarting the game.
dxrender.settings.mode.tooltip:
AUTO: Vulkan GPU backend when a hardware GPU works, otherwise the CPU rasterizer.
GPU: Vulkan GPU backend only, start-up reports an error if it cannot run.
CPU: DX Render software rasterizer and SPIR-V interpreter.
Restart required.
dxrender.settings.preset.tooltip:
SAFE: half of the cores, steady pacing, least heat.
BALANCED: all cores but one.
EXTREME: every core, larger tiles, no pacing.
dxrender.settings.threads.tooltip: Threads of the CPU rasterizer. CPU backend only.
dxrender.settings.tile.tooltip: Screen tile size of the CPU rasterizer. CPU backend only.
dxrender.settings.texture_cache.tooltip: Recycle released textures of the same size instead of allocating new memory. CPU backend only (the GPU backend sub-allocates GPU memory itself).
dxrender.settings.occlusion.tooltip: Hierarchical depth test that skips hidden triangles per tile. CPU backend only (GPUs do this in hardware).
dxrender.settings.fast_shaders.tooltip: Use native versions of the hottest shaders, each verified against the SPIR-V interpreter. CPU backend only.
dxrender.settings.pacing.tooltip: Show frames at an even cadence when the swapchain does not pace them itself (no vsync).
dxrender.settings.overlay.tooltip: Measured FPS, frame time, CPU/GPU time, draw calls, triangles, memory and shader cache in the top left corner.
dxrender.settings.bench.tooltip: Write one CSV line per second to dxrender-bench.csv in the game directory.
